title: Bromcom Computers plc v United Learning Trust
description: UL's procurement for a cloud-based MIS used across 57 schools was challenged by Bromcom on three grounds: (1) unlawful averaging of individual scores without moderation, (2) one-sided data-transfer cost adjustment applied only to Bromcom's bid, and (3) permitting Arbor's rebate linked to a separate contract. The court found in favour of Bromcom on all three grounds.
contracting_authority_name: United Learning Trust and United Church Schools Trust
